definition: Understanding of a situation only after it has happened.
exampleSentence: In hindsight, had we booked tickets earlier, we would have saved money.
Had unforeseen delays not intervened, the bridge would be open today.

definition: An event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering.
exampleSentence: If emergency teams had arrived earlier, the catastrophe would have been averted.

definition: One of two or more available possibilities.
exampleSentence: If an alternative route had existed, commuters would not be stranded now.

definition: The action or process of intervening.
exampleSentence: Without diplomatic intervention, a major trade war would have erupted.

definition: A review of a past course of events or period of time.
exampleSentence: In retrospect, we would have purchased flight tickets much earlier.

definition: Occurring in turn repeatedly; available as another possibility.
exampleSentence: Had we considered alternate routes, we would not have been stranded.

definition: The expression of disapproval or disappointment.
exampleSentence: She uttered no reproach, though his reckless decisions cost dearly.

definition: The forming of a theory or conjecture without firm evidence.
exampleSentence: Whether they would have triumphed without funding remains pure speculation.

definition: Not carried out or brought to completion.
exampleSentence: He spoke wistfully about unfulfilled dreams of theatrical fame.
